description: Domain registration lookup via IANA RDAP DNS bootstrap only (registrar, status, nameservers, events). Rejects IP literals and private names. Rate-limited, ~5s timeout, SSRF-safe (no private redirects). Price $0.003 via x402.

domain.description: Domain name to look up (hostname, not an IP)

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key. Echoed back; a credit-pack redemption with the same request_id and body is charged once.

name: whois_rdap
